title: MakersConfig
description: config/makers.yaml (ADR-0050; FR-CON-16, FR-CON-17, FR-CON-19): where each deliverable can be made. For a format listed in formats the start plan offers native (made in Tilo: always first, never listed here) and then each partner in order; a format not listed is made natively with no choice shown. Code applies MK-01 to MK-08 (makers.rules.md); a model never picks. Every key is required and no other key is allowed. The loader also checks what the schema cannot: a connector partner is declared in config/connectors.yaml or config/canva.yaml with that action as T3 and gated, and an mcp partner is a tool of config/mcp.yaml's allowlist with that action type; it refuses the whole file otherwise.

formats.description: The formats that offer a choice, keyed by deliverable format, each with at least one partner (MK-01).

preselect_suggested.description: MK-05: true selects a suggested ready partner before Start (the person can switch back to native); false always selects native first.

partners.description: The partner options after native, in display order.

action.description: The action that makes the deliverable there: the connector's T3, gated action (build_handoff, create_design) or the MCP tool's action type. Picking the partner authorises nothing; this action keeps its own card (MK-07).

large_site.description: MK-03: a website deliverable is large when its brief text names more than max_native_pages pages or one of the needs. The brief text is the goal, the deliverable's title and each constraint, lower-cased with whitespace collapsed; a need matches as whole words; a page count is a number (digits, or a word from one to twenty) directly before page or pages, a space or hyphen between.

max_native_pages.description: The most pages one self-contained HTML file is asked to hold (in-page sections or tabs).

needs.description: Lower-case phrases of one to four words naming a need a single file with no network cannot meet (sign-in, a database, payments).

need.description: Lower-case words separated by one space or hyphen.
